about: Vectors for enroll-token/1 (DEC-0084, docs/specification/ceremonies.md#a-headless-machine). verify: verifyEnrollToken(token, {record, genesis, at}) with record the estate's current revision (record when given, else fixtures/positive/estate-record-first.json, as the hub and the node hold it), genesis that record's revision 1 digest, and at an RFC 3339 instant read as the clock. Each token is signed by the EdDSA test passkey of fixtures/vectors/estate-record.json over SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 form of its statement (the register's enroll-token/1, DEC-0063). redeem: redeemEnrollToken(token, machineKey, proof, ledger) with ledger a map built from the [nonce, entry] pairs and proof the presented #sig key's signature over the register's enroll-join/1 statement {digest: sha256 of the token's statement bytes, nonce} (statement.join; ES256 as 64 bytes r||s low-S, Ed25519 as 64 bytes): a first use answers the record the hub stores, a second use (by any key) answers reused with the line the hub logs.

pairingAbout: Vectors for the estate ceremonies' pairing (DEC-0084, docs/specification/ceremonies.md). A side commits to sha256: + hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 RFC 8785 form of {type: fabric-enroll-commit/1, role, keys, nonce}, with genesis (the digest of the estate's revision 1) for the trusted side (commits: pairingCommit), both commit before either reveals, and each checks the other's reveal against its commitment (reveals: checkReveal(commit, reveal, expected?)). The comparison code is the first 5 bytes, big-endian, of SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 transcript {type: fabric-enroll-code/1, new: {keys, nonce}, trusted: {keys, nonce, genesis}}, modulo 10^6, as six digits (codes: comparisonCode(new, trusted)); a port computes it only through checkedComparisonCode(newCommit, new, trustedCommit, trusted), which checks each reveal against its commitment first (checkedCodes). The estate fingerprint is five groups of five digits from SHA-256 over {type: estate-fingerprint/1, digest} of revision 1 (fingerprints: estateFingerprint). rendezvous: rendezvousVerdict(openedAt, messages, at), at an RFC 3339 instant read as the clock — one exchange within 600 s, burned by any failure, and one abort accepted after both reveals. join: joinListed(record, new, trusted, genesis) on the revision that adds the machine, genesis the digest of the revision 1 the new machine verified its chain from. ownKeys: ownKeysDecision(record, machine, held). Every refusal answers {ok: false, problem} and nothing throws. The lax cases are what a careless port gets wrong: non-canonical JSON, a swapped role, folded hex.
